record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Concerning Expansive Systems
record.context_brief: Lyapunov exponents for the torus map in equation (1)
record.original_question: Consider the map f: T^2 -> T^2 defined by f(x, y) = (2x + y - (c/(2π)) sin(2πx), x + y - (c/(2π)) sin(2πx)). For parameter values c > 1, does this map have positive Lyapunov exponents on a set of positive measure?

evidence.quote: 2.5. Another Example Let f : T2 → T2 be defined by f(x,y ) = ( 2x +y− 1/(2π)c sin(2πx), x+y− 1/(2π)c sin(2πx) ). (1)
Open Problem 10.3: For c > 1 the map given in (1), has positive Lyapunov exponents on a set of positive measure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{T}^2 = \mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2$ denote the two-dimensional torus, equipped with normalized Lebesgue measure. For a real parameter $c$, define the smooth map $f_c \colon \mathbb{T}^2 \to \mathbb{T}^2$ by
$$f_c(x,y) = \left(2x + y - \tfrac{c}{2\pi}\sin(2\pi x),\; x + y - \tfrac{c}{2\pi}\sin(2\pi x)\right) \pmod{1}.$$
For $c = 0$, $f_0$ is the linear Anosov (cat) map $(x,y)\mapsto(2x+y,\,x+y)$, which is area-preserving and uniformly hyperbolic. One verifies that $f_c$ is area-preserving for all $c$. For a point $p\in\mathbb{T}^2$ and a nonzero vector $v\in T_p\mathbb{T}^2$, the Lyapunov exponent of $f_c$ at $p$ in direction $v$ is
$$\lambda(p,v) = \limsup_{n\to\infty} \tfrac{1}{n}\log\|Df_c^n(p)\,v\|,$$
and one says $f_c$ has a positive Lyapunov exponent at $p$ if $\lambda(p,v) > 0$ for some $v\neq 0$.

Question: For every $c > 1$, does the set
$$\{p \in \mathbb{T}^2 : f_c \text{ has a positive Lyapunov exponent at } p\}$$
have positive Lebesgue measure?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem concerns a non-uniformly hyperbolic perturbation of the Arnold cat map, related to Lewowicz-type examples on the boundary of Anosov diffeomorphisms. No published proof establishing positive Lyapunov exponents on a positive-measure set for c>1 was found; related cases (e.g., the standard map) remain a longstanding open problem, with only numerical evidence. The question appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Mixed dynamics in a parabolic standard map
status_evidence.snippet: Smooth symplectic diffeomorphisms of the 2-torus studied as unfolding of an almost-hyperbolic diffeomorphism on the boundary of Anosov diffeomorphisms (Lewowicz).
status_evidence.claim: This map belongs to a family of perturbations of an Anosov diffeomorphism related to Lewowicz, where coexistence of zero and positive Lyapunov exponents is a central open problem.

status_evidence.title: Standard map (Encyclopedia)
status_evidence.snippet: Umberger & Farmer (1985) showed numerically that there is a fat fractal set on which the dynamics of the standard map has a positive Lyapunov exponent; rigorous proof remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous positivity-of-Lyapunov-exponents questions for area-preserving perturbations of integrable/linear maps remain open with only numerical evidence.
